metadata.title: Duality Portrait with High-Contrast Red Background

retrievalProfile.description: A symmetrical back-to-back portrait of the same subject representing contrasting personas against a vibrant red backdrop with expressive script lettering.
excludeWhen: minimalist or pastel color palettes are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: Two identical subjects positioned back-to-back, looking over their shoulders toward the viewer. One side features dark styling (black hair, black lipstick, black corset), while the other features light styling (white corset, softer makeup). The background is a solid, saturated red with a slight central glow.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical back-to-back positioning of the central figures
Color contrast between black and white garments against a red field
Dynamic script typography overlapping the top of the subjects
Consistent studio lighting creating sharp highlights on skin and hair
coreInvariants: High-gloss studio finish on skin and hair

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two waist-up figures centered, filling approximately 80% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The point where the two subjects' backs meet in the center of the image.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top script, move down to the subjects' faces, and follow their gaze outward to the edges.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space at the top and bottom, with the red background framing the silhouettes.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm Skin Tones and Silver Jewelry
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation background with high value contrast between the black and white outfits.

letterConstructionRules: Varying stroke thickness mimicking a dry brush
Connected lowercase letters with detached, oversized capitals
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'a' and 'n' have sharp, angular exits
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Hand-drawn script paired with a smaller, cleaner version of the same script for secondary info.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the aggressive, fast-motion feel of the lettering.
Matches the high-contrast, expressive nature of the strokes.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of two identical women back-to-back against a solid red background. The woman on the left wears a black lace-up corset and black lipstick; the woman on the right wears a white lace-up corset and natural makeup. High-gloss lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom dry-brush script lettering across the top third of the image. Use white for the right side of the text and black for the left side to mirror the subjects' outfits.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid, vibrant red?
Does the typography have a textured, brushed appearance?
Is there a clear black-vs-white contrast in the styling?

mustRedesign: Ensure script is original and not a direct copy of existing logos

mustAchieve: Clean separation between subjects and background

postGenerationChecks: Check for symmetrical balance between the two figures
Verify the red background is consistent and saturated
Ensure the script lettering feels integrated with the hair/heads
Confirm the black/white contrast is maintained in the outfits
recipe.reuseFormula: Symmetrical Duality + Saturated Backdrop + Gestural Script = Pop Icon Aesthetic
